messages:
Maya Patel: Heads up — onboarding package for nova-13b (weights + tokenizer) just landed from partner. Needs provenance checks + quant bring-up.
Kevin Li: Got it. Priority? Any immediate blockers?
Maya Patel: Customer is regulated so mark P1. Suggested intake checklist:
1) Verify S3 checksums & PGP signer
2) Confirm KMS envelope + key id
3) Populate registry manifest and storage tags
4) Tokenizer validation (vocab/merges sanity)
5) Smoke run: CPU FP32 functional test
6) Baseline: GPU FP16 perf + quality on eval-suite-v3
7) Quant sweep (q4_k_m, q3_k, fp16->int8 exploratory) with regression gating
Kevin Li: Paste the S3 paths + checksum commands here so Sanjay can run them.
ops-bot: artifact-upload-complete for s3://partners/nova-13b/v1 at 2026-03-19T12:34:10Z (uploader: partner-ci)
Maya Patel: S3 paths: `s3://partners/nova-13b/v1/weights.pt` and `s3://partners/nova-13b/v1/tokenizer.json`
Checksums: `aws s3 cp s3://partners/nova-13b/v1/weights.pt ./weights.pt && sha256sum weights.pt`
Expected checksum file at: `s3://partners/nova-13b/v1/weights.pt.sha256`
KMS envelope metadata should include `x-amz-meta-kms-key-id: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01`
Sanjay Rao: I'll run checksum + tokenizer probe now. For tokenizer I'll run small decode/encode roundtrip and check vocab coverage on our eval prompts.
Sanjay Rao: Command I use for tokenizer smoke:
```
python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json'); print(t.encode('Hello world').tokens)"
```
Elaine Gomez: For quantization experiments — start with q4_k_m profile, 2048 context, 128-token evals across our semantic and instruction suites. We'll track perplexity delta and instruction-following score. Regression gates:
- instruction_score >= baseline - 2.5
- semantic_f1 >= baseline - 3
Also keep a human spot-check batch of 50 prompts.
Kevin Li: Estimate: FP16 baseline (~8 GPU-hours), quant sweep (~40 GPU-hours across sweep). Recommend using dedicated dev pool to avoid noisy neighbors.
Maya Patel: Registry link: https://console.redwood/models/nova-13b/v1 — I'll create manifest there and attach provenance blob (signer, sha256, k87 key id).
Maya Patel: I'll also create an intake ticket and assign to @Sanjay and @Elaine. Please ack when you can so I can set ETA.
Sanjay Rao: ack, starting checksum now.
Elaine Gomez: ack :white_check_mark: Will prepare eval configs and add golden prompts list.
Kevin Li: +1 :thumbsup: Ping me if any test shows quality drop > threshold, we'll pause quant and run deeper analysis.
Maya Patel: Thanks — I'll update the ticket with timestamps and expected completion window (48–72h). (reacted :eyes:)
